info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Billings-v1-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Billing API provides access to detailed billing information for subscription services. It enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of billing records associated with streaming subscriptions. Typical consumers include billing administrators and finance teams who need to analyze revenue streams and track billing cycles. This endpoint supports necessary reporting features, ensuring transparency and accountability in subscription billing operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed billing information associated with your subscriptions. It provides an overview of the costs, payment methods, and billing cycles for active subscriptions.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving billing information related to subscriptions. This must adhere to the specified schema, which includes the necessary parameters to successfully access billing details.

201.description: Resource created successfully, indicating that the billing subscription has been initiated.
